_about: FIT College advisor lookup. Rules (first match wins): 1) courses[course] is an advisor id -> that advisor; 2) not an Australian citizen/PR -> courses['*overseas*']; 3) postcodes[postcode] -> that advisor; 4) otherwise -> advisors['_fallback'].
